deadline.value: One common deadline for all 14 Biosciences PhD home programs: 11:59:59pm PST, December 1, 2026.
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Autumn 2027-28 is Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 11:59:59 pm (PST).

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject scores are not considered by Biology, Neurosciences, Biomedical Data Science or most home programs (Biophysics alone lists a Math/Physics subject test as optional).
gre_subject.quote: Home Program GRE General Test GRE Subject Test GRE Subject Test Notes Biochemistry Not Considered Not Considered Biology Not Considered Not Considered Biomedical Data Science Not Considered Not Considered

gre_general.value: None of the 14 home programs considers the GRE General Test.
gre_general.quote: Home Program GRE General Test GRE Subject Test GRE Subject Test Notes Biochemistry Not Considered Not Considered Biology Not Considered Not Considered

supervisor.value: You are admitted to a home program and do lab rotations across all 14 programs before choosing a thesis lab.
supervisor.quote: Regardless of your Home Program, you have full access to faculty in all of the other Home Programs for laboratory rotations and potential thesis work.

funding.value: All Biosciences PhD students in good standing get a stipend, tuition and health insurance. But funding for international students is limited, so the number of international admits each year depends on funding and space.
funding.quote: All Biosciences PhD students in good standing receive a competitive stipend, as well as tuition and health insurance.

also.quote: We have a limited number of fellowships (which include a yearly stipend, tuition, and health and dental insurance) available to the most highly competitive international applicants. | Admittance to the Biosciences Programs for international applicants varies from year to year, depending on funding and available space.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) is the minimum requirement.
entry_route.quote: You must hold, or expect to hold before enrollment at Stanford, a U.S. bachelor’s degree or its international equivalent from a college or university of recognized standing.

notes: One application covers 14 home programs (choose up to two), including Biology, Neurosciences, Biomedical Data Science, Genetics, Immunology, Biochemistry, Biophysics and Cancer Biology. 2026-27 stipend: $58,460. International places are limited by funding.
name: Stanford Biosciences PhD Programs (14 Home Programs)
